static_traits.name: Lin Hui
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因Anxiety而紧张；有少数密友但not yet与其讨论Anxiety；Anxiety影响睡眠与日常购物习惯
static_traits.medical_history: 大学考试期间曾有类似Anxiety；此前not yet接受心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly and can describe experiences in concrete terms; tone is negative and accompanied by self-criticism; tends to predict the worst outcomes and compare with others; cooperativeness is acceptable, and holds a cautious yet open attitude toward trying new methods

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常感到Anxiety和压力，尤其是在每天要与Student打交道之前。这种感觉从我刚开始教书时就出现，并随着责任和压力的增加而加重。
basic_info.core_demands: 由于Anxiety和压力not断增加，已显著影响工作表现与个人福祉，因此寻求更好的应对策略。
growth_experiences: 大学期间在考试情境中出现明显的Anxiety体验；当时not yet接受任何心理治疗Intervention，且No major physical illness史。
Teacher职业初期因新环境与外界期待导致中等强度压力；随后随着职责增加与压力上升，逐渐发展为每日在进入教室前或与Student发生具有挑战性的互动时出现的Anxiety与紧张。

core_beliefs: 我without法胜任挑战，最终会失败
我必须始终保持完美的耐心，否则就是not称职

special_situations.event: 在进入教室前，Anticipation当天课堂与Student可能出现具有挑战性的情形
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果课堂出现任何挑战而我not能保持完全耐心，就说明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doing deep breathing and mindfulness practice before entering the classroom to try to stabilize emotions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的Student今天会考验我的耐心

special_situations.event: 在与Student发生具有挑战性的互动时（课堂进行中）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能顺利处理每一次课堂问题，就证明我not适合当老师
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises self-demands and tries to over-control classroom details to avoid mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应付not了，I am not competent enough

special_situations.event: 在游戏中遇到高难度关卡而卡关
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像其他玩家一样快速通关，就说明我永远达not到他们的水平
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 暂停、观看教程、在网上寻求技巧与建议
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会像其他玩家那样厉害

special_situations.event: Right after passing a Boss, immediately encountering a new level challenge
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果后续又卡住，之前的任何成功都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽略已取得的进步，只关注当前困难

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to prove oneself competent and in stable control of the classroom and challenges
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为not称职、被比较后显得not足，从而感到羞耻与失败
defense_goal: 维持高标准与Self-monitoring以避免被negate
通过提前Anticipation最坏结果来降低失控与被批评的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能失败的Teacher/玩家
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔且易于negate自己的Student、同事或更优秀的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When interaction with others is tense or they are frustrated in challenging tasks (such as class difficulties, getting stuck in games)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将外界压力与评价内化为对自我价值的negate，认为自己“not配”“not够好”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与接纳，先验证感受与努力；邀请识do not自我批评的语言，use具体例证对其进行温柔挑战，并共创可行的小步策略。

manifestations: 有少数密友但not yet与其讨论自身Anxiety与压力，倾向独自承受
When stuck at a game level, ignores existing achievements; the meaning of victory is erased by subsequent difficulty, leading to questioning the value of the effort invested

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评（“I am not good enough”“我not配”）
对建议持怀疑但谨慎尝试

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Demands of oneself with 'must' and 'should' high standards (such as must be completely patient with zero mistakes)
将外界期待内化为对自我价值的评判

exception_events.target_problem: 在遇到高难度关卡时，来访者通常会Self-denial、心情低落，并显著降低对游戏的享受。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 最近一次在连续几天的练习后成功击败一个Boss，短暂体验到成就与Self-efficacy。
exception_events.reason: 做法not同：观看教程、寻求他人技巧建议并分阶段练习；情境调整：通过暂停与休息后再继续挑战，使精力与专注有所恢复。

positive_force: 具备并主动use多种应对策略（深呼吸、正念、观看教程、寻求技巧）
Has a few close friends as potential support resources
愿意尝试记录成功以对抗负性思维
In difficult tasks, has achieved concrete success (defeating the Boss), having self-efficacy experiences that can be evoked
negative_force: 自我苛责与非黑即白思维
预测not yet来与读心术等认知歪曲
忽视正面细节的心理过滤
工作Interpersonal tension与被评价恐惧

target_behavior.behavior: 在进入教室前及课堂中出现显著的Anxiety与紧张，耐心下降
antecedent: 进入教室前Anticipation当天课堂挑战
与Student发生具有挑战性的互动
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“预测not yet来”“非黑即白思维”等认知歪曲影响，将可能的课堂困难灾难化并与能力not足相联系。
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的体验（失败与被评价）并试图通过高度警觉获得控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、耐心下降、Tense relationships with colleagues、睡眠与日常购物习惯被扰

target_behavior.behavior: 在游戏卡关时强烈Self-denial与Low mood，Reduced interest
antecedent: 面对高难度关卡或比较其他玩家表现时
刚取得小成就后立即遇到新难关
target_behavior.core_reason: 比较与非黑即白思维、心理过滤导致将挫折视为全面失败并negate已有成功。
target_behavior.function: 通过自责与Withdrawal来回避挫败感与not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 游戏的愉悦与意义感下降，负性情绪增加，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt
